If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

moves.flavor: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.long: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.flavor: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.short: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20
moves.flavor: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.short: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
moves.long: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.short: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.flavor: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.short: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.long: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage.
moves.flavor: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.long: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.flavor: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Confuses the target.
moves.long: Confuses the target.
moves.flavor: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.short: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.
moves.long: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.short: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.flavor: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.short: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
moves.long: Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP. Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.
moves.flavor: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.short: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
moves.long: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
moves.long: If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.short: User and target both faint after three turns.
moves.long: Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.short: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.flavor: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.short: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, maxing out after five turns.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.
moves.flavor: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.

moves.long: User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon. The following move effects are passed: * Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.short: Has double power against, and can hit, Pokémon attempting to switch out.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power. This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.
moves.flavor: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.short: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs. Power can range from 30 to 70.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. moves.flavor: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.short: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
moves.long: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.flavor: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.short: Hits the target two turns later.
moves.long: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.short: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.
moves.flavor: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.short: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
moves.long: Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.
moves.flavor: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

moves.short: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.
moves.flavor: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

moves.short: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends. Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.short: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied. If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.
moves.flavor: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

moves.short: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile. Ignores the random factor in the damage formula. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

moves.short: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.
moves.long: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.

moves.short: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

moves.short: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
moves.long: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.
moves.flavor: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.short: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
moves.long: Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row. When the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead. The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.
moves.flavor: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.short: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.
moves.long: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.
moves.flavor: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.short: Burns the target.
moves.long: Burns the target.
moves.flavor: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.
moves.long: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.
moves.flavor: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

moves.short: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.
moves.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.short: If the user takes damage before attacking, the attack is canceled.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.short: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
moves.long: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.

moves.flavor: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.long: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging. moves.flavor: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.short: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.
moves.long: Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.short: User and target swap items.
moves.long: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.short: Copies the target’s ability.
moves.long: User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. moves.flavor: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.

moves.short: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
moves.long: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.
moves.flavor: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

moves.short: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.
moves.long: Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Prevents the user from leaving battle. User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.
moves.long: Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them. Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise. The user may still use U-turn to leave the field. This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.

moves.short: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.
moves.flavor: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

moves.short: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.
moves.long: The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user. Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected. Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.

moves.short: User recovers the item it last used up.
moves.long: User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails. Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.
moves.flavor: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.short: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.
moves.flavor: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.short: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.
moves.long: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.short: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
moves.long: Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail. If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail. Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.
moves.flavor: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.short: Target drops its held item.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.
moves.flavor: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
moves.long: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.
moves.flavor: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.short: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.
moves.flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.short: User and target swap abilities.
moves.long: User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.short: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.
moves.long: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.short: Cleanses the user of a burn, paralysis, or poison.
moves.long: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: If the user faints this turn, the PP of the move that fainted it drops to 0.
moves.long: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.
moves.flavor: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

moves.short: Steals the target’s move, if it’s self-targeted.
moves.long: The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag. If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect. If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.long: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.flavor: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.short: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.long: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.short: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.
moves.flavor: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

moves.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.flavor: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.short: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Bounce and Fly users.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.
moves.flavor: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.short: Causes a one-hit KO.
moves.long: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.
moves.flavor: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.flavor: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.short: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.long: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

moves.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage.
moves.flavor: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

moves.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
moves.flavor: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.
moves.flavor: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.short: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.flavor: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.

moves.short: Takes the target’s item.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

moves.short: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.flavor: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.short: Halves all Fire-type damage.
moves.long: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.
moves.flavor: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
moves.flavor: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.
moves.flavor: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

moves.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

moves.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.flavor: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.short: Hits the target two turns later.
moves.long: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.

moves.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
moves.flavor: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.long: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.
moves.flavor: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.short: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
moves.long: For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop. Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes. Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect. *Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.
moves.flavor: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

moves.short: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
moves.long: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.
moves.flavor: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

moves.short: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.
moves.flavor: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.short: User faints. Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
moves.long: User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.
moves.flavor: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

moves.short: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.
moves.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

moves.short: Power and type depend on the held berry.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Hits through Protect and Detect.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.
moves.flavor: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.short: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.
moves.flavor: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.short: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
moves.long: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.
moves.flavor: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.short: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
moves.long: Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail. If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.
moves.flavor: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

moves.short: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
moves.long: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.
moves.flavor: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

moves.short: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.
moves.flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.short: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.
moves.flavor: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.short: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.
moves.flavor: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

moves.short: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.
moves.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

moves.short: Target cannot use held items.
moves.long: Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail. This effect is passed by Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail. This move ignores Sticky Hold. If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.short: Transfers the user’s major status effect to the target.
moves.long: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.
moves.flavor: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

moves.short: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200 If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.
moves.long: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: User swaps Attack and Defense.
moves.long: The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

moves.short: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.
moves.long: The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.

moves.short: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.
moves.long: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
moves.long: If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power. If the target moves before the user, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Uses the target’s last used move.
moves.long: Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user. This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
moves.flavor: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.short: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.
moves.long: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.
moves.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

moves.short: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.
moves.long: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.
moves.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

moves.short: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.
moves.flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.short: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.short: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
moves.long: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.
moves.flavor: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

moves.short: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. This move is not affected by Iron Fist.
moves.flavor: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

moves.short: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
moves.long: Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.
moves.flavor: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.short: User and target swap stat changes.
moves.long: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.
moves.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

moves.short: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.
moves.long: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

moves.short: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
moves.long: For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves. If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail. This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
moves.flavor: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.short: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
moves.flavor: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

moves.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.flavor: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.short: Never misses.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
moves.flavor: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.short: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
moves.long: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
moves.flavor: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.short: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.flavor: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.long: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.flavor: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
